messages.text: Hi, I just finished my exam and am looking to grab some food. Can I get one Coke, three orders of onion rings, and two large fries, please? My name is Marcus.
Hey Marcus, congrats on finishing your exam! I have that down as one Coke, three orders of onion rings, and two large fries. Will you be picking that up?
Yes, I will be picking that up.

perfect, lemme get 2 of those pls. deliver to 4722 Vine Blvd unit 27B. payin cash and can u make change for a 20?

yep, that's it 👍
hey
u guys got a manager around rn?

k lemme talk to them pls, order got messed up last time
hey!! lemme get 4 americanos small pls ☕️

wait actually lol just kidding, changing that. just gonna do two americano smalls w caramel syrup

HEY THERE!!! MORNING CRUMB!!!
Hi! Welcome to Morning Crumb, what can I get for you today?
I NEED A BREAKFAST SANDWICH PLEASE
Sure thing! Would you like that on an English muffin, croissant, or bagel?
ON A BAGEL PLS

WAIT ACTUALLY NO BACON!! ADD AVOCADO TO IT THO

YES THATS IT!! ILL BE THERE IN 20 MIN. NAME IS TARA
hey morning crumb its tara ordering for a meeting today
Hi Tara! What can I get started for you?
can i get 1 medium drip coffee w vanilla syrup and also a fruit cup pls
hey lemme get two hot chocolate and a cappuccino small rn pls
Sure! Hot chocolate in small, medium or large? And should the cappuccino be small too, or a different size?
oh the cappuccino is small, and the hot chocolates r small too thx
Hi there. I'd like one large drip coffee with caramel syrup and almond milk, please. Quick question first: does the cappuccino come with whole milk by default, or can I get it with skim?
Hi! Yes, the cappuccino comes with whole milk, but you can swap in skim, oat, or almond for no extra fuss. Want a medium?
Yes, a medium cappuccino, please. Then a couple of other things: one medium hot chocolate with vanilla syrup, and I'd like oat milk in it instead of whole milk.
Got it. So: 1 large drip coffee with caramel syrup and almond milk, 1 medium cappuccino, and 1 medium hot chocolate with vanilla syrup and oat milk instead of whole milk. Is that everything?
That's everything. I'll pick it up. My name is Leah.
